```llp
pred seek(object) : alf.
pred near(object) : alf.
pred unlock(object, receptacle) : alf.
pred unlocked(object, receptacle) : alf.
pred grab(object) : alf.
pred got(object) : alf.
pred carry(object, receptacle) : alf.
pred there(object, receptacle) : alf.
pred unlock_dest(object, receptacle) : alf.
pred unlocked_dest(object, receptacle) : alf.
pred drop(object, receptacle) : alf.
drop go_obj
drop open_obj
drop take_plain
drop take_open
drop go_target
drop here_target
drop open_target
drop put_open
drop put_plain
%% {O} is elsewhere: I send for it.
plan_seek [dyn] : tofetch(O) * $at(L) * $objat(O, L2) * L <> L2 -o seek(O).
%% I go to where {O} is.
go_obj [dyn] : seek(O) * at(L) * objat(O, L2) * L <> L2 -o at(L2) * objat(O, L2) * near(O).   % @nav
%% Near {O}.
near_it [dyn] : near(O) -o tofetch(O).
%% {R} holds {O} and is shut.
plan_unlock [dyn] : tofetch(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $openable(R) * $closed(R) * $inrecep(O, R) -o unlock(O, R).
%% I open {R}.
open_obj [dyn] : unlock(O, R) * at(L) * $recat(R, L) * closed(R) -o at(L) * opened(R) * checked(R) * unlocked(O, R).   % @access
%% {R} is open.
unlocked_it [dyn] : unlocked(O, R) -o tofetch(O).
%% {O} is in reach.
plan_grab_plain [dyn] : tofetch(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $notopenable(R) * $inrecep(O, R) * $objat(O, L) -o grab(O).
%% {O} is in reach, {R} open.
plan_grab_open [dyn] : tofetch(O) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $openable(R) * $opened(R) * $inrecep(O, R) * $objat(O, L) -o grab(O).
%% I take {O} from {R}.
take_plain [dyn] : grab(O) * at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $notopenable(R) * $pickupable(O) * inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree -o at(L) * holds(O) * holding * got(O).   % @grasp
%% I take {O} from {R}.
take_open [dyn] : grab(O) * at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $openable(R) * opened(R) * $pickupable(O) * inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree -o at(L) * opened(R) * holds(O) * holding * got(O).   % @grasp
%% I have {O}.
got_it [dyn] : got(O) -o todeliver(O).
%% {O} goes to {R}.
plan_carry [dyn] : todeliver(O) * $at(L) * $dest(R) * $recat(R, L2) * L <> L2 -o carry(O, R).
%% I carry {O} to {R}.
go_target [dyn] : carry(O, R) * at(L) * $recat(R, L2) * L <> L2 -o at(L2) * there(O, R).   % @nav
%% At {R}.
there_it [dyn] : there(O, R) -o arrived(O, R).
%% {R} is right here.
here_target [dyn] : todeliver(O) * $at(L) * $dest(R) * $recat(R, L) -o arrived(O, R).
%% {R} must be opened first.
plan_unlock_dest [dyn] : arrived(O, R) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $openable(R) * $closed(R) -o unlock_dest(O, R).
%% I open {R} to put {O} in.
open_target [dyn] : unlock_dest(O, R) * at(L) * $recat(R, L) * closed(R) -o at(L) * opened(R) * checked(R) * unlocked_dest(O, R).   % @access
%% {R} is open now.
unlocked_dest_it [dyn] : unlocked_dest(O, R) -o arrived(O, R).
%% Into the open {R}.
plan_drop_open [dyn] : arrived(O, R) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $openable(R) * $opened(R) -o drop(O, R).
%% Onto {R}.
plan_drop_plain [dyn] : arrived(O, R) * $at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $notopenable(R) -o drop(O, R).
%% I put {O} in {R}.
put_open [dyn] : drop(O, R) * at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $openable(R) * opened(R) * holds(O) * holding -o placed * at(L) * opened(R) * inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree.   % @place
%% I put {O} on {R}.
put_plain [dyn] : drop(O, R) * at(L) * $recat(R, L) * $notopenable(R) * $rtype(R, RT) * $otype(O, OT) * $cancontain(RT, OT) * holds(O) * holding -o placed * at(L) * inrecep(O, R) * objat(O, L) * handsfree.   % @place
```
